description: Send a message, or reply with in_reply_to. Subject to your mailbox's limits and its workspace's policy. Give each message a fresh idempotency_key and reuse it only to retry that same message: it then goes out once. A held result is waiting for a person to approve it. It is not an error, and sending again sends a second copy.

agent.description: A machine-readable part for an agent recipient: a JSON object sent beside the text.

from.description: Which of your addresses to send as. Empty sends as your primary address.

html.description: HTML body, beside or instead of text.

idempotency_key.description: A key unique to this message. A repeat with the same key returns the first result and sends nothing; a different message under a used key is not sent.

in_reply_to.description: The message_ id this answers. Threads the reply and fills its recipients.

on_behalf_of.description: Send as another agent, by its ag_ id. Needs a send-on-behalf grant; refused as policy_refused without one.

reply_all.description: With in_reply_to: answer every recipient of the original, not only its sender.

subject.description: Subject line. A reply takes the original's when left out.

to.description: Recipient addresses. May be left out on a reply, which takes them from the message replied to.

name: bud_send
